description: Explain the conditional nature of auto-renewal, check specific terms and prices, set an early reminder for your decision, verify cancellation confirmation if needed, then follow Wealth Blueprint to build wealth on purpose.

segments.text: Your free trial renews only if auto-renewal applies. Check your agreement for the specific cancellation cutoff.
segments.visual_intent: A physical paper agreement card lies flat on a neutral surface. A blank calendar sheet rests beside it, showing no specific dates or moving elements.

segments.text: Open your agreement now. Read the stated renewal price and record the specific cancellation cutoff date listed there clearly for yourself to see later.
segments.visual_intent: The same physical paper agreement remains visible with its text legible but unmarked. The adjacent blank calendar stays empty without any drawn reminders or cutoff lines added to the raster.

segments.text: Set a reminder before that cutoff arrives. Decide whether to keep the useful service or cancel it, then check for provider confirmation if you choose cancellation.
segments.visual_intent: A static illustration of a standard wall calendar shows two distinct marks: one small dot representing a reminder and another separate mark indicating the cancellation deadline, both fixed on the page surface.

segments.text: Follow Wealth Blueprint and build wealth on purpose today.
segments.visual_intent: A static illustration of the 'Wealth Blueprint' logo centered clearly in a neutral background with no moving elements or embedded text other than what the renderer adds as captions.

title: Your free trial has a second deadline
